name: animacao-viva
displayName: Unreal Engine 5 advanced animations and more
description: Unreal Engine 5's animation toolkit, translated for bodies with NO skeleton — characters built from primitives, geometry creatures, ships, turrets. State machine with cross-fade, 1D/2D blend spaces, per-region layered animation (run and attack at once), additive poses, notifies with marks and windows, and phase sync that stops feet sliding. Not a rig, not a retargeter: the same ideas, done in math, for anyone who poses their characters by hand. Manual written in Portuguese (PT-PT).
